title: 测试、验收与审计 Checklist Pack
summary: Stage-specific review checklists for 测试、验收与审计.
when_to_use: Use this after a draft, prototype, or build exists and you need a concentrated 测试、验收与审计 review pass.
starter_steps: Use 测试、验收与审计 Checklist Pack as a review pass after a draft, prototype, or build already exists.
Mark the failed checks first, then group them into a short fix order.
Do not treat every failed line as equally important; separate identity risks from polish issues.
Repeat the checklist after the next meaningful revision.
